touches.text: tree: the nexus graph-tree face (deposit, counsel, propose) over the librarian's trees. It is the same tool everywhere, not chart's: it is written as chart's only because chart was where it was first defined at that level. It stays a tool and does not fold into the librarian's verbs; a learning block holding its trees by the librarian's delegation (4.3.1.6) works them through it. A learning block that needs a special adaptation gets a subclass. (Q#54, Akien 2026-11-05)
Knowledge: one list of nodes, owned by the librarian.

The librarian owns every tree and delegates ownership of some to the devices that learn: CodeMother, chart, any learning block holds its own trees by the librarian's delegation (Law 6: delegation through the owner's gate). Why: two holders with different weights over the same nodes have different perspectives and can debate points, and the librarian, asked anything, can look at the query from both. (Akien 2026-11-05)
Walks go through the librarian's published trees tool, not the bus (2.2.8.1.2).
